independent_review.scope: Bounded source/read-only category, authority, recovery, clock, archive and publication review

limits: No cause is inferred for absent runs.
The deployed manifest matches the already independently verified release snapshot; no unchanged website rebuild was dispatched.
GitHub Actions permissions inventory returned HTTP403 Resource not accessible by integration; this does not establish that scheduling is disabled.
Actual final-source evidence and prospective grades cannot exist before their games and verified final evidence.
Focused software tests are synthetic evidence and do not count as genuine forecasts or accuracy validation.

software_checks.command: node --test --test-isolation=none --test-name-pattern='actual Python normalized development fixture|history-based minutes render|performance' web/tests/production.test.mjs
software_checks.note: The lowercase performance alternative matched no additional test.

software_checks.command: node --test --test-isolation=none --test-name-pattern='scored grades independently recompute|DNP uses one shared outcome|corrections append originals' web/tests/production.test.mjs
